name: Apify
one_liner: Platform for running web scraping and automation Actors, with REST API, client libraries, and MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API token from the Console, sent as a Bearer Authorization header (recommended) or as a token URL parameter. Scoped and expiring tokens are supported. OAuth applies to the hosted MCP server only.
access_notes: Create a free Console account, then a personal API token on the Integrations page; the token is shown only once. Paid plans and pricing are not on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free account and personal token, a documented REST API with an OpenAPI schema, and standard bearer auth. Per-Actor pricing and rate limits were not verified on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: All aspects of the Apify platform can be controlled via a REST API

auth.quote: You can either pass the token via the Authorization HTTP header or the URL token query parameter.

access.quote: If you don't have an account, you can create a free one there.

api_surface.quote: The Apify API is built around HTTP REST, uses predictable resource-oriented URLs, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
